verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents its own event-driven rules in two forms. Alerts fire when a metric or spend crosses a threshold and notify via Slack, GitHub Actions, or Webhooks. Evaluator rules automatically run LLM-as-a-Judge scoring on sampled live production traces. The available action types are narrow (notifications or scoring), and the docs offer only one-line mentions. missing for 10: a general rule/automation builder with arbitrary actions, detailed docs on rule conditions and event types, independent or hands-on corroboration of alerting/webhook triggers.
